rules.title: Missing USB library links
rules.advice: Verify the local base game, updates and DLC, then rebuild only their missing routing entries. Keep existing unrelated entries and confirm the console backup afterwards.

rules.title: Converted game metadata
rules.advice: Use the built-in metadata integrity check. The installed record, metadata filesystem and complete referenced content hashes must agree. A known catalogue entry does not bypass these checks.

rules.title: Files missing or incomplete
rules.advice: Reinstall the affected content from your original backup. Repair cannot download or recreate missing game data. Keep saved progress and avoid deleting individual NCAs.

rules.title: Games from another system
rules.advice: Scan the USB drive and review the import preview. Register complete game families using the existing drive files and the current system permissions.

rules.title: Game permission unavailable
rules.advice: Check permissions in the current system. If a required ticket really is missing, reinstall from your original backup. This catalogue contains no tickets or keys.

rules.title: USB map files missing
rules.advice: Check the dedicated Nexus console save and restore its links only after validating them against this system and connected drive.

rules.title: SAEKO: verified metadata conversion
rules.advice: This exact metadata variant was observed with a rewritten distribution header. Use full local metadata and referenced-file validation before repairing links. Do not rename, patch or replace NCAs using this entry.
